name: Bali
headline: Bali in small, golden days.
subheadline: A quick visual note from Canggu, Ubud, and Uluwatu.
introduction: A short Bali overview for the photo page: soft mornings, green inland roads, cliff light, and a slower island pace.
shortDescription: A short Bali overview: cafe mornings, rice-field roads, cliff views, and soft sunset light.
description: A short Bali overview: cafe mornings, rice-field roads, cliff views, and soft sunset light.
longDescription: A short Bali overview for the photo page.
overview: A compact island overview: Canggu for easy mornings, Ubud for green quiet, and Uluwatu for cliff-side sunset light.
weatherNote: Dry season is easier for road days. Short rain can still happen, so keep the plan loose.
travelTips: Do not stack Canggu, Ubud, and Uluwatu into one day.
Add buffer time for traffic, especially around sunset.
Carry a light sarong or cover-up for temples.
Pick accommodation by area, not only by room photos.
notFor: A trip where every hour needs to be tightly scheduled.
Travelers who dislike traffic or moving between areas.

seoTitle: Bali Slow Travel Guide | Canggu, Ubud, Uluwatu
seoDescription: A slow editorial Bali guide for Canggu cafe mornings, Ubud rice fields, Uluwatu cliffs, temple roads, sunsets, and flexible island days.
entranceFee: Usually 25k - 100k IDR depending on temple, beach, or viewpoint
thingsToKnow: Traffic adds time fast. Pick one area per day, check temple dress codes, and avoid planning back-to-back sunset spots.
